overview_description.description: Lab0 specializes in the development of robotic technology, focusing on creating innovative solutions that span across hardware and software. The company aims to achieve industrial autonomy on a global scale, leveraging its expertise in robotics to enhance manufacturing processes and productivity. With a team of skilled professionals, Lab0 is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the realm of industrial robotics, offering multi-domain product development to meet the diverse needs of the manufacturing industry.
